HFCL to invest ₹400 crore in optical fibre cable manufacturing expansion

HFCL has approved an investment of ₹400 crore to expand its optical fibre cable manufacturing capacity. The company plans to increase its production capabilities for optical fibre and cables. This expansion aims to meet growing demand in the sector. The investment decision was made by the company's board.
